_attribution: Common adhkar; Arabic and translations are widely transmitted in the Sunnah and have no single copyrighted source.

items.translation: There is no god but Allah.
I seek the forgiveness of Allah.
Glory be to Allah, and praise Him.
Glory be to Allah, the Magnificent.

items.arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
items.transliteration: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
items.translation: There is no might nor power except with Allah.
Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
items.transliteration: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Muhammad
items.translation: O Allah, send peace and blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.
O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being.
